name: aswang-game
description: Task runner for the ASWANG harness. Not a JS project — node is here because the Claude Code hooks are node scripts, and npm gives every gate one name that hooks, agents and plan Verify lines can all call.

scripts.verify:fast: npm run --silent analyze && npm run --silent check:remotes && npm run --silent check:secrecy && npm run --silent verify:harness:fast
scripts.verify: npm run --silent analyze && npm run --silent lint && npm run --silent fmt:check && npm run --silent check:remotes && npm run --silent check:secrecy && npm run --silent check:config && npm run --silent check:scope && npm run --silent check:ratelimit && npm run --silent check:debug && npm run --silent check:testcount && npm run --silent test:unit && npm run --silent verify:harness
scripts.verify:harness: node .claude/scripts/harness-selftest.mjs && node .claude/scripts/lessons.mjs audit && node .claude/scripts/hook-heartbeat.mjs && node .claude/scripts/candidates.mjs status
